messages:
leila: Heads-up: the Ruby SDK is removing the legacy `models` accessor in v2. Quickstart users following old samples are hitting `NoMethodError: undefined method 'models'`. I started a migration PR for docs and quickstart.

dan: Which gem versions break? I can search examples.

leila: Affected: ruby-sdk < 1.8.0. Most docs call `client.models[...]` or `client.models.get`. New API uses `model_versions` or direct model alias ids.

frank: Minimal v2 example for the guide:
```ruby
client = Redwood::Client.new(api_key: ENV['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])
resp = client.generate(model: 'rw-embed-stable', input: 'hi')
puts resp.output_text
```
Include an alternative that shows listing model_versions when teams need selector logic.

maya: Add a Troubleshooting entry with exact errors so search picks it up: "NoMethodError: undefined method `models'" and "KeyError: 'models' not found in response".

dan: We should offer a last-resort shim for pinned apps, but mark it strongly as temporary.

frank: Shim suggestion (docs only):
```ruby
# Legacy shim - last resort
class Redwood::Client
  def models
    @models_proxy ||= ModelsProxy.new(self)
  end
end
```
And show ModelsProxy translating to model_versions. Add big WARNING to upgrade gem >=1.8.0.

leila: Logistics: update quickstart, migration guide, and ruby-examples. PRs: docs#5230, quickstart-ruby#88, ruby-examples#212. Ops: run snippet smoke on ruby 2.7/3.0/3.2.

ops-bot: Smoke results queued. ruby-2.7 failed (keyword args deprecation), ruby-3.0 passed, ruby-3.2 passed. See CI: https://github.com/redwood-inference/quickstart-ruby/actions/runs/4567

maya: Add a note in the migration doc: prefer Ruby >= 3.0; call out keyword-arg compatibility. Also add redirect from /v1/ruby/models -> /v2/ruby/model_versions. Create a redirect ticket.

dan: Draft release blurb: "Legacy `models` accessor removed; use `model_versions` or direct aliases (e.g., `rw-embed-stable`). See Ruby migration guide." Keep short.

leila: I'll merge staging after quickstart CI green or after we add compatibility note. Backport to stable after that. ops-bot: please create ticket and add PRs to the deprecation board.

ops-bot: Ticket DOCS-804 created; PRs added to column "deprecation-ruby". :white_check_mark:

frank: One last thing: ensure examples for private deployments call out older private images may bundle older runtime versions. Don't expose internal flags in public docs.

leila: Done. Thanks team — closing after backport.
